text: Chapter 3. Insurance and Indemnification D. Employee Benefits Liability (EBL) Insurance [3:280] Standard form CGL policies do not cover an employer's liability under ERISA or state law relating to an employee benefits program. To cover this risk, ISO has published a standard form endorsement to its CGL policies, “Employee Benefits Liability Coverage” (EBL) (CG 04 35 03 05). Other insurance forms are also available, including a “Labor Management Trust Fiduciary Policy” that indemnifies insureds who manage pensions for others against claims based upon “any actual or alleged breach of fiduciary duty” (including both ERISA and common law fiduciary duties). [See Pension Trust Fund for Operating Engineers v. Federal Ins. Co. (9th Cir. 2002) 307 F3d 944, 950] 1. [3:281] Covered Acts and Omissions: EBL coverage is limited to providing coverage for the negligent administration of employee benefits programs.
